name: p-doc
description: P-Doc: a desktop word processor with documents versioned in your own GitHub, online or offline.

scripts.tokens: node agentic-craft/tools/build-tokens.mjs --src packages/tokens/design --css packages/tokens/tokens.css --md docs/design/tokens.md && node agentic-craft/tools/check-tokens.mjs --src packages/tokens/design --checks packages/tokens/design/checks.json
scripts.lint:design: node agentic-craft/tools/lint-styles.mjs apps/desktop/src/renderer && node agentic-craft/tools/build-tokens.mjs --src packages/tokens/design --css packages/tokens/tokens.css --md docs/design/tokens.md --check
